units.locator: Article 32.7. Calculation of the period of deprivation of a special right
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.7. Calculation of the period of deprivation of a special right
units.label: Art. 32.7

units.locator: Article 32.7. Calculation of the period of deprivation of a special right
units.text: 1. The period of deprivation of a special right shall begin on the day the ruling imposing the administrative penalty of deprivation of that special right enters into legal force.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 32.7

units.locator: Article 32.7. Calculation of the period of deprivation of a special right
units.text: 1.1. Within three working days from the day the ruling imposing the administrative penalty of deprivation of the relevant special right enters into legal force, the person deprived of the special right must surrender the documents specified in parts 1 - 3.1 of Article 32.6 of this Code to the body executing that type of administrative penalty or, if those documents have been lost, report the loss to that body within the same period.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 32.7

units.locator: Article 32.7. Calculation of the period of deprivation of a special right
units.text: 1.2. In the case specified in part 2 of Article 32.6.1 of this Code, the person deprived of the relevant special right must surrender the driving licence or tractor driver-operator’s (tractor driver’s) certificate in accordance with the procedure and within the time limits specified in part 1.1 of this article, calculated from the day enforcement of the ruling depriving that person of the relevant special right is resumed.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 32.7

units.locator: Article 32.7. Calculation of the period of deprivation of a special right
units.text: 1.3. In the case specified in part 3 of Article 32.6.1 of this Code, the person deprived of the relevant special right must surrender the driving licence or tractor driver-operator’s (tractor driver’s) certificate in accordance with the procedure and within the time limits specified in part 1.1 of this article, calculated from the day the new ruling imposing the administrative penalty of deprivation of the relevant special right enters into force.
units.label: Part 1.3 Art. 32.7

units.locator: Article 32.7. Calculation of the period of deprivation of a special right
units.text: 2. If a person deprived of a special right evades surrender of the relevant licence (special permit) or other documents, the period of deprivation of the special right shall be interrupted. The interrupted period of deprivation of the special right shall continue from the day the person surrenders, or has withdrawn from them, the relevant licence (special permit) or other documents, or the day the body executing that type of administrative penalty receives the person’s statement that those documents have been lost.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 32.7

units.locator: Article 32.7. Calculation of the period of deprivation of a special right
units.text: 3. If a person deprived of a special right is subjected to an administrative penalty depriving them of the same special right, the period of deprivation shall begin on the day following the day the previously imposed administrative penalty expires.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32.7

units.locator: Article 32.8. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest
units.text: Article 32.8. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest
units.label: Art. 32.8

units.locator: Article 32.8. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.8. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest
units.label: Art. 32.8

units.locator: Article 32.8. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest
units.text: 1. A judge’s ruling imposing administrative arrest shall be enforced by internal affairs bodies immediately after it is issued.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 32.8

units.locator: Article 32.8. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest
units.text: 2. A person subjected to administrative arrest shall be held in custody at a place determined by internal affairs bodies. A personal search of the person subjected to administrative arrest shall be conducted when the ruling imposing administrative arrest is enforced.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 32.8

units.locator: Article 32.8. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest
units.text: 3. The period of administrative detention shall count towards the period of administrative arrest.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32.8

units.locator: Article 32.8. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest
units.text: 4. Administrative arrest shall be served in accordance with the procedure specified by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 32.8

units.locator: Article 32.8. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest
units.text: 5. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest may be suspended for up to seven days or terminated by a judge upon a written application by the person subjected to administrative arrest if exceptional personal circumstances arise (serious illness (state of health), the death of a close relative or close person, or an emergency causing significant material damage to the person subjected to administrative arrest or that person’s family), or on the basis of a medical opinion that the person has an illness, injury or disability preventing service of administrative arrest. The period of suspension of administrative arrest shall not count towards the period of administrative arrest served.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 32.8

units.locator: Article 32.8. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest
units.text: 6. If a person in respect of whom enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest was suspended evades returning to the place of administrative arrest within the prescribed period, the police shall detain that person until they are delivered to the place of administrative arrest.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 32.8

units.locator: Article 32.9. Enforcement of a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 32.9. Enforcement of a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 32.9

units.locator: Article 32.9. Enforcement of a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.9. Enforcement of a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 32.9

units.locator: Article 32.9. Enforcement of a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. A ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation shall be enforced:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 32.9

units.locator: Article 32.9. Enforcement of a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.text: 1) by border authorities, for the administrative offences specified in part 2 of Article 18.1, part 1.1 of Article 18.2 and part 2 of Article 18.4 of this Code;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 32.9

units.locator: Article 32.9. Enforcement of a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.text: 2) by the federal executive body authorised to ensure the established procedure for the operation of courts and to enforce judicial acts and acts of other bodies and officials, where a judge, body or official imposes on a foreign citizen or stateless person the administrative penalty of expulsion from the Russian Federation in the form of forced expulsion from the Russian Federation, except for the administrative offences specified in part 2 of Article 18.1 and part 2 of Article 18.4 of this Code.
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 32.9

units.locator: Article 32.9. Enforcement of a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. A ruling on administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in the form of forced expulsion from the Russian Federation may be enforced immediately if the foreign citizen has identity documents and funds to purchase travel documents, and has applied for immediate enforcement of the ruling.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 32.9

units.locator: Article 32.9. Enforcement of a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.text: 3. The application shall be lodged with the court at the location of the special institution in which the foreign citizen has been placed and considered by a judge within five days of its receipt. Following consideration of the application, the judge shall issue a procedural order granting the application and directing immediate enforcement of the ruling, or refusing the application.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32.9

units.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 32.10

units.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 32.10

units.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. A ruling on administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation shall be enforced by officially handing the person over to a representative of the authorities of the foreign state to which the person is expelled, or by the supervised independent departure of the person subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 32.10

units.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.text: 1.1. A ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation in the form of forced expulsion from the Russian Federation shall be enforced immediately after it is issued, by placing those foreign citizens or stateless persons in the special institutions specified by Federal Law of 25 July 2002 No. 115-FZ “On the Legal Status of Foreign Citizens in the Russian Federation”, followed by administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation, or by directly carrying out administrative expulsion of those persons from the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 32.10

units.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.text: 1.2. Failure by a foreign citizen or stateless person to pay an administrative fine imposed on them and (or) the existence of obligations imposed on that person by a judge in accordance with this Code shall not prevent execution of the administrative penalty of expulsion.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 32.10

units.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. The authorities of the foreign state to whose territory or through whose territory a foreign citizen or stateless person is expelled shall be notified of administrative expulsion of that person from a crossing point at the State Border of the Russian Federation if administrative expulsion is provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation with that state.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 32.10

units.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.text: 3. If handing over a person subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation to a representative of the authorities of the foreign state is not provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation with that state, administrative expulsion of the person shall take place at a location determined by the border authorities.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32.10

units.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.text: 4. Enforcement of a ruling on administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation shall be documented by a bilateral or unilateral statement, which shall be attached to the ruling or the enforcement proceedings materials.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 32.10

units.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.text: 5. Repealed with effect from 1 January 2012. - Federal Law of 06.12.2011 No. 410-FZ.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 32.10

units.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.text: 6. Foreign citizens or stateless persons subjected to the administrative penalty of expulsion from the Russian Federation in the form of supervised independent departure from the Russian Federation must leave the Russian Federation within five days after the day the ruling imposing the relevant administrative penalty enters into force.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 32.10

units.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
units.text: 7. The federal executive body exercising federal state control (supervision) in the sphere of migration shall monitor compliance by a foreign citizen or stateless person with the ruling on their administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in the form of supervised independent departure from the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 32.10

units.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification
units.text: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification
units.label: Art. 32.11

units.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification
units.label: Art. 32.11

units.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification
units.text: 1. A ruling imposing disqualification must be complied with by the person held administratively liable immediately after the ruling enters into legal force.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 32.11

units.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification
units.text: 2. A ruling imposing disqualification shall be enforced by terminating the agreement (contract) with the disqualified person.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 32.11

units.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification
units.text: When concluding an agreement (contract), the person authorised to conclude it must request information on whether the individual is disqualified from the body maintaining the register of disqualified persons.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 32.11 · “When concluding an agreement (contract), the person authorised…”

units.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification
units.text: 3. A register of disqualified persons shall be formed to keep records of persons in respect of whom rulings imposing disqualification have entered into legal force. The register shall be maintained by a federal executive body authorised by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32.11

units.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification
units.text: The register of disqualified persons shall contain the following information: surname, given name, patronymic, date and place of birth; the full name and taxpayer identification number of the organisation in which the disqualified person worked when committing the administrative offence, and the position held by that person in the organisation; the article of this Code establishing administrative liability for the offence; the name of the body that drew up the administrative offence record; the position, surname, given name and patronymic of the judge who issued the ruling imposing disqualification; the period of disqualification; the dates on which disqualification begins and expires; and information on review of the ruling imposing disqualification.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32.11 · “The register of disqualified persons shall contain the…”

units.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification
units.text: A person shall be deemed removed from the register of disqualified persons upon expiry of the disqualification period, or when the federal executive body authorised to maintain the register has received a judicial act that has entered into force quashing the ruling imposing disqualification.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32.11 · “A person shall be deemed removed from the register of…”

units.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification
units.text: The federal executive body authorised to maintain the register of disqualified persons shall enter information in the register no later than three working days from the day it receives a copy of a ruling imposing disqualification that has entered into force or a judicial act reviewing the ruling imposing disqualification.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32.11 · “The federal executive body authorised to maintain the register…”

units.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification
units.text: The information contained in the register of disqualified persons shall be open to public inspection.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32.11 · “The information contained in the register of disqualified…”

units.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification
units.text: The federal executive body authorised to maintain the register of disqualified persons shall publish the information contained in it on its official website on the Internet. No charge shall be made for access to the information in the register published by the authorised federal executive body on its official website on the Internet.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32.11 · “The federal executive body authorised to maintain the register…”

units.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification
units.text: Interested persons have the right, for a fee, to obtain information contained in the register of disqualified persons in the form of an extract concerning a particular disqualified person or a certificate stating that the requested information is absent. The period for providing the extract or certificate may not exceed five working days from the day the federal executive body authorised to maintain the register receives the relevant request. The amount of the fee for the extract or certificate shall be determined by the Government of the Russian Federation. The form of the extract or certificate provided to interested persons and the procedure for providing it shall be determined by the federal executive body authorised to maintain the register of disqualified persons.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32.11 · “Interested persons have the right, for a fee, to obtain…”

units.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification
units.text: 4. A copy of a ruling imposing disqualification that has entered into force shall be sent by the court that issued it to the body authorised by the Government of the Russian Federation or its territorial body.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 32.11

units.locator: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities
units.text: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities
units.label: Art. 32.12

units.locator: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities
units.label: Art. 32.12

units.locator: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities
units.text: 1. A ruling issued by a judge, body or official imposing the administrative penalty of suspension of activities shall be enforced by a bailiff immediately after it is issued.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 32.12

units.locator: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities
units.text: 2. During administrative suspension of activities, security seals shall be affixed, premises, places for storing goods and other material valuables, and cash offices shall be sealed, and other measures shall be applied to carry out the actions specified in the ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities that are necessary to execute that administrative penalty.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 32.12

units.locator: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities
units.text: During administrative suspension of activities, measures that may cause irreversible consequences for the production process or for the functioning and preservation of life-support facilities are prohibited.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 32.12 · “During administrative suspension of activities, measures that…”

units.locator: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities
units.text: 3. Administrative suspension of activities shall be terminated early by the judge, body or official that imposed that administrative penalty upon an application by a person engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, a legal entity, the Presidential Commissioner for Entrepreneurs’ Rights of the Russian Federation or a commissioner for entrepreneurs’ rights in a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, if it is established that the circumstances forming the grounds for the penalty have been eliminated. The judge, body or official that imposed administrative suspension of activities must request an opinion from the official authorised under Article 28.3 of this Code to draw up the administrative offence record. Upon receipt of the judge’s request, the official authorised under Article 28.3 of this Code to draw up the administrative offence record shall, for the purpose of preparing the opinion, check whether the circumstances forming the grounds for administrative suspension of activities have been eliminated. The opinion shall be given in writing, specifying the facts showing whether the person engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity or the legal entity has eliminated those circumstances. The opinion shall not be binding on the judge, body or official that imposed administrative suspension of activities and shall be assessed under the rules established by Article 26.11 of this Code. Any disagreement by the judge, body or official with the opinion must be reasoned. The application shall be considered by the judge, body or official that imposed administrative suspension of activities within five days of its receipt, in accordance with the procedure specified by chapter 29 of this Code, taking account of the particular provisions of this article. The person engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity or the legal entity’s statutory representative shall be summoned to participate in consideration of the application and shall have the right to give explanations and submit documents.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32.12

units.locator: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities
units.text: 4. After examining the documents submitted, the judge, body or official that imposed the administrative penalty of suspension of activities shall issue a ruling terminating execution of that administrative penalty or refusing the application.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 32.12

units.locator: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities
units.text: A ruling on early termination of execution of the administrative penalty of suspension of activities shall state the information specified in Article 29.10 of this Code and the date of resumption of activities by the person engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity or by the legal entity, its branch, representative office, structural subdivision or production site, and of the operation of units, facilities, buildings or structures, the conduct of particular types of activities (work) or the provision of services.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 32.12 · “A ruling on early termination of execution of the…”

units.locator: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities
units.text: 5. Upon expiry of the period established in the ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities, if execution of the penalty has not been terminated early on the grounds and in accordance with the procedure specified in parts 3 and 4 of this article, the official authorised under Article 28.3 of this Code to draw up the administrative offence record shall check whether the circumstances forming the grounds for administrative suspension of activities have been eliminated.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 32.12

units.locator: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities
units.text: If the check establishes that the circumstances forming the grounds for administrative suspension of activities have not been eliminated, the official authorised under Article 28.3 of this Code to draw up the administrative offence record may draw up a new administrative offence record, and measures to secure the administrative offence proceedings may be applied in accordance with the procedure specified by chapter 27 of this Code.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 32.12 · “If the check establishes that the circumstances forming the…”

units.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work
units.text: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work
units.label: Art. 32.13

units.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work
units.label: Art. 32.13

units.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work
units.text: 1. A judge’s ruling imposing compulsory work shall be enforced by a bailiff in accordance with the procedure established by federal legislation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 32.13

units.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work
units.text: 2. The types of compulsory work and the list of organisations in which persons subjected to that administrative penalty serve their compulsory work shall be determined by local self-government bodies in agreement with the territorial bodies of the federal executive body authorised to carry out compulsory enforcement of enforcement documents and ensure the established procedure for the operation of courts. Types of compulsory work requiring special skills or knowledge may not be assigned to persons who lack those skills or knowledge.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 32.13

units.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work
units.text: 3. A person subjected to the administrative penalty of compulsory work shall begin serving it no later than ten days from the day a bailiff initiates enforcement proceedings.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 32.13

units.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work
units.text: 4. Bailiffs shall keep records of persons subjected to the administrative penalty of compulsory work, explain to them the procedure and conditions for serving compulsory work, agree with local self-government bodies the list of organisations in which those persons serve compulsory work, monitor their conduct and keep a cumulative record of the time they have worked.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 32.13

units.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work
units.text: 5. Persons subjected to the administrative penalty of compulsory work must comply with the internal rules of the organisations in which they serve compulsory work, work conscientiously at the sites assigned to them for the compulsory work period established by the court, notify the bailiff of a change of residence and appear when summoned by the bailiff.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 32.13

units.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work
units.text: 6. Granting a person subjected to the administrative penalty of compulsory work annual paid leave at their principal place of employment shall not suspend execution of that administrative penalty.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 32.13
